description: This file implements a modified merge sort function `git_qsort_s`, which is inspired by the GNU C Library's qsort implementation. It includes safety checks, support for a context pointer, and custom merge logic. The code also includes internal utility functions and memory management to perform a stable sort with an external temporary buffer.
